definition.en: The Index of Industrial Production (IIP) is a composite indicator that measures the short-term changes in the volume of production of a basket of industrial products during a given period with respect to a chosen base year.
definition.hi: The Index of Industrial Production (IIP) is a composite indicator that measures the short-term changes in the volume of production of a basket of industrial products during a given period with respect to a chosen base year.

importanceInUpsc.en: IIP is a critical high-frequency indicator for the Indian economy, frequently cited in the Economic Survey and by the RBI to gauge industrial health. Understanding its methodology and components is essential for GS-3 questions related to industrial growth, economic policy, and macroeconomic trends.
